title: When the selected location(s) hold no in-stock parts on the resolved date, the no-data message shows
permissions_required: A user with access to at least two locations and the inventory-reports permission.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A location you can access holds no in-stock (positive-quantity, non-core) parts.
steps: 1. Scope the Location filter to only the empty location.
expected: 1. The report shows the no-data message "Empty bays, endless possibilities. Get Going!" instead of rows, and no totals row.
